_note: uv sync --extra aigamestore: the vendored aigamestore-gym env (vendor/aigamestore), which needs a Chromium browser (system Chrome by default). Lock-stepped: fps must equal 60 / frame_skip (10 with the default frame_skip 6).
_levels_note: No levels (an endless runner): each episode is one run, and ends when it is lost.
_keys_note: The env's action is MultiBinary over the game's keys, in aigamestore_gym.GAME_KEYS order -- game4: 0=SPACE, 1=UP -- so 'keys' values are those indices (the JSON key is what the subject presses) and held keys combine. The env relabels the on-canvas hints to the pressed key; keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
